<style>
  .tab-with-content{padding:50px 0;background-color: #fff;position:relative;z-index: 0;}
  .tab-with-content .bg-img{display:none;}
  .tab-with-content__heading{max-width:700px;width:100%;font-weight: 700;color: var(--background-primary-color);margin-bottom: 20px;}
  .tab-with-content__description{max-width:700px;width:100%;font-size: 18px;line-height: 28px;margin-bottom:40px;}
  .tabbed-content{display: flex;flex-wrap: wrap;}
  .tabbed-content .tabs {display: none;}
  .tabbed-content .item{position: relative;}
  .tabbed-content .item::before{content: attr(data-title);display: block;padding: 24px;border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-four);background: #fff;color: var(--gray-two);font-size: 18px;font-weight: 400;line-height: 28px;position:relative;transition: 0.3s;}
  .tabbed-content .item.active::before{padding: 24px 24px 0;}
  .tabbed-content .item:after{content: "";width: 24px;height: 24px;background: url(https://4066240.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/4066240/viewlift/arrow-down.svg) no-repeat center;top: 26px;right: 20px;position: absolute;display: inline-block;filter: grayscale(1);}
  .tabbed-content .item.active:after{filter: initial;transform: rotate(180deg);}
  .tabbed-content .item.active::before{background: var(--secondary-gradient-color);color:#fff;border: none;}
  .tabbed-content .item .item-content{opacity: 0;visibility: hidden;height: 0;transition: 0.3s;}
  .tabbed-content .item.active .item-content{opacity: 1;visibility: visible;height: auto;background: var(--secondary-gradient-color);padding: 10px 24px 24px;}
  .tabbed-content .item-content h3{color: #fff;font-weight: 700;margin-bottom:10px}
  .tabbed-content .item-content h6{margin-bottom: 30px;color:#fff;}
  .tabbed-content .item-content .cta{text-align: center;margin-top:24px;}
  .tabbed-content .cta .cta_button{padding: 12px 16px;background-color:transparent;border-radius: 12px;border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-six);font-size: 18px;font-weight: 600;line-height: 24px;letter-spacing: 0.4px;text-transform: uppercase;display: inline-block;color:#fff;transition:0.3s;}
  .tabbed-content .cta .cta_button:hover{background-color:var(--accent-color);border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-six);color:var(--background-primary-color);}

  @media(min-width:992px){
    .tab-with-content{padding:100px 0;}
    .tab-with-content .bg-img{position:absolute;z-index:-1;top:0;right:0;display:block;}
    .tabbed-content .tabs {display: block;width: 320px;}
    .tabbed-content .tabs li:first-child a{border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-four)}
    .tabbed-content .tabs li a{display: block;padding: 28px 24px;border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-four);background: #fff;color: var(--gray-two);font-size: 18px;font-weight: 400;line-height: 28px;position:relative;transition: 0.3s;}
    .tabbed-content .tabs li a:hover,.tabbed-content .tabs li .active{background: var(--secondary-gradient-color);color:#fff;}
    .tabbed-content .tabs li a img{position: absolute;top: 26px;right:24px;transform: rotate(-90deg);filter: grayscale(1);width: 32px;height: 32px;}
    .tabbed-content .tabs li a:hover img,.tabbed-content .tabs li .active img{filter:initial;}
    .tabbed-content .item{width: calc(100% - 320px);max-width: 760px;padding-left: 90px;display: none;}
    .tabbed-content .item.active{display: block;}
    .tabbed-content .item::before,.tabbed-content .item:after{display: none;}
    .tabbed-content .item.active .item-content{background: #fff;}
    .tabbed-content .item-content h3{color: var(--secondary-dark-color);}
    .tabbed-content .item-content h6{color:var(--gray-two)}
    .tabbed-content .cta .cta_button{padding: 12px 16px;background-color:var(--secondary-color);border-radius: 12px;border: 1.5px solid var(--secondary-color);font-size: 18px;font-weight: 600;line-height: 24px;letter-spacing: 0.4px;text-transform: uppercase;display: inline-block;color:#fff;transition:0.3s;}
    .tabbed-content .cta .cta_button:hover{background-color:var(--background-secondary-color);border: 1.5px solid var(--background-secondary-color);color:#fff;}
  }
  .tab-with-content__description{color:#000000;}@media(min-width:768px){ }
</style>

<script>
  // Function to handle tab control
  function tabControl() {
    var tabs = document.querySelector('.tabbed-content .tabs'); 

    if (isElementVisible(tabs)) {
      // If tabs are visible
      var tabLinks = tabs.querySelectorAll('a');

      tabLinks.forEach(function(link) {
        link.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
          event.preventDefault();
          var targetId = this.getAttribute('href').substring(1);
          var tabsContainer = this.closest('.tabs');
          var buttons = tabsContainer.querySelectorAll('a');
          var tabbedContent = tabsContainer.closest('.tabbed-content');
          var items = tabbedContent.querySelectorAll('.item');

          buttons.forEach(function(button) {
            button.classList.remove('active');
          });

          items.forEach(function(item) {
            item.classList.remove('active');
          });

          this.classList.add('active');
          document.getElementById(targetId).classList.add('active');
        });
      });
    } else {
      // If tabs are not visible
      var items = document.querySelectorAll('.item');

      items.forEach(function(item) {
        item.addEventListener('click', function() {
          var container = this.closest('.tabbed-content');
          var currId = this.getAttribute('id');
          var allItems = container.querySelectorAll('.item');
          var tabLinks = container.querySelectorAll('.tabs a');

          tabLinks.forEach(function(link) {
            link.classList.remove('active');
          });

          allItems.forEach(function(item) {
            item.classList.remove('active');
          });

          this.classList.add('active');
          container.querySelector('.tabs a[href$="#' + currId + '"]').classList.add('active');
        });
      });
    }
  }

  // Function to check if an element is visible
  function isElementVisible(element) {
    return element.offsetWidth > 0 || element.offsetHeight > 0;
  }

  // Event listener for window resize
  var resizeTimer;
  window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
    clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
    resizeTimer = setTimeout(function() {
      tabControl();
    }, 250);
  });

  // Initial call to tabControl
  tabControl();
</script>
